subfiles.title: List of papers concerning corporations in Kwantung
subfiles.about: An index identifies five Dairen consular reports from 1934–1936 concerning foreign companies operating or attempting to establish operations in the Kwantung Leased Territory.
subfiles.summary: Lists Vincent's 1934 reports on Chrysler's blocked Dairen plant and Grummon's 1936 reports on a Franco-Japanese venture and British closure.

interest: Tracks constrained foreign corporate activity in Japanese Dairen.
